title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Computation of an Agreement Settlement Figure
content:
## Accounts receivable statement

The figure a building owner settles a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record at is built from the instalment arrears, the charges for instalments left unpaid taken at the share the office collects them at, the other ancillary charges standing on the agreement, the recovery of trips lost to locked plant, the credits issued on the agreement, the prompt settlement allowance and the credit owed for the pre-agreement inspection.

### The figures that make up the statement

| Line | What it is |
|---|---|
| Instalment arrears | the instalments invoiced on the agreement less every payment received on it |
| Charges for instalments left unpaid | those charges standing on the agreement, collected in full |
| Other ancillary charges | the ancillary charges standing on the agreement other than the charges for instalments left unpaid |
| Recovery of trips lost to locked plant | nothing is recovered for trips lost to locked plant |
| Credits issued on the agreement | set against the settlement figure in full |
| Prompt settlement allowance | no prompt settlement allowance is allowed |
| Pre-agreement inspection credit | no credit is owed for the pre-agreement inspection |

### Assembling the figure

The instalment arrears, the charges for instalments left unpaid at their collected share, the other ancillary charges and the recovery of lost trips are summed; from that sum the credits issued, the prompt settlement allowance and the pre-agreement inspection credit are subtracted; the figure is rounded to the nearest cent once, on the final result alone, and never falls below nothing.

### Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

An agreement carrying 6 000.00 USD of instalments invoiced, 4 500.00 USD of payments received, 180.00 USD of charges for instalments left unpaid, 340.00 USD of other ancillary charges and 675.00 USD of credits issued.

- Instalment arrears: 6 000.00 USD less 4 500.00 USD, that is 1 500.00 USD.
- Charges for instalments left unpaid at their collected share: 180.00 USD.
- Other ancillary charges: 340.00 USD. Recovery of lost trips: none.
- Sum: 2 020.00 USD.
- Subtracted: credits issued 675.00 USD; prompt settlement allowance none; pre-agreement inspection credit none.
- Rounded once on the final result: **1 345.00 USD**.
